title: Add SSO to Demo app
content:
Note: some or all of this text should be moved to repo for default pipeline.

To enable SSO for environments set up by pipeline for development and test a representation of the application at hand is needed in AD. You are not allowed according to cloud governance policies to create an application registration so order an service principal via Inter IKEA Service Portal. Request read access for your non production Azure subscription.

After you have received service principal and done basic configuration you need to as well configure for use in SSO in the proxy function (ref pipeline doc) for the CI application deployments. To do this follow steps below.

Configure call back URL by adding a Single-page Application platform on the Authentication blade for you service principal. The callback URL follows the pattern <app-url>/.auth/login/aad/callback and app-url is the Azure Funcion application URL that you find on the overview page. You as well need to enable issuing of ID Tokens. As an example check out the service principal used in the Default pipeline configuration.

Azure Function should be deployed via Terraform.
